title: Administration
description: Center setup, users, catalog, prices, and system.

noAccess.title: You do not have access to this section
noAccess.description: Ask a system administrator to grant the permission if you need it.

users.title: Users
users.description: Create accounts, assign roles, reset passwords, and unlock accounts.

roles.title: Roles & permissions
roles.description: The permission matrix per role, with safe defaults.

settings.title: Center settings
settings.description: Center profile and logo, print templates, and document numbering.

centerPage.title: Center page
centerPage.description: The public page patients see at the portal's door: hours, doctors, notices and contact.

policies.title: Policies
policies.description: Partial payment, follow-up visits, discount limits, and perform-first roles.

departments.title: Departments & doctors
departments.description: Departments, rooms, doctors, specialties, and weekly clinic hours.

reasonCodes.title: Reason lists
reasonCodes.description: Reasons for cancellations, discounts, refunds, and other recorded actions.

catalog.title: Service catalog
catalog.description: Consultations, lab tests, procedures, drugs, and consumables.

priceLists.title: Price lists
priceLists.description: Price lists with dated versions and bulk percentage updates.

payers.title: Payers
payers.description: Insurers and companies: contracts, coverage rules, and exclusions.

banks.title: Banks
banks.description: Banks and wallets that transfer, QR and card payments come through.

imports.title: Imports
imports.description: Import patients, items, and prices from Excel with preview.

system.title: System status
system.description: Server, backups, restore tests, and updates.

export.title: Data export
export.description: A full copy of patients, visits, invoices, payments, stock and claims as CSV files.

audit.title: Audit trail
audit.description: Who changed what and when, with the reason, for every record.

publicSite.title: Public site & booking
publicSite.description: Switch the center website, online booking and patient sign-in on or off, and set the booking rules.

common.name: Name
common.codeRule: Use capital letters, digits, - and _, starting with a letter.

users.name: Name
users.deviceRoleAlone: The waiting-room display role is held alone: remove the other roles or use a separate account.
users.deviceRoleHint: A screen account: held alone, never with a person's roles
users.createHint: The user signs in with this temporary password and must change it at once.
users.search: Search by name, username or phone
users.caption: Staff accounts
users.resetHint: The user's open sessions end and the new password must be changed at the next login.
users.unlockHint: The reason is recorded in the audit log with your name and the time.
users.tempPasswordHint: At least 8 characters, not only digits. Give it to the user in person.
users.deactivateHint: They are signed out at once and cannot sign in until an administrator activates the account again. Their records stay.

roles.keysHint: Use the arrow keys to move between cells, Home and End to go to the ends of a row, and Space to grant or revoke.
roles.confirmHint_one: {{count}} change takes effect at once for every user with that role. The reason is recorded in the audit log.
roles.confirmHint_other: {{count}} changes take effect at once for every user with those roles. The reason is recorded in the audit log.
roles.protectedHint: Locked permissions keep administrators able to manage users and roles.

settings.logoHint: PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP, up to 1 MB. Stored on this server.
settings.removeLogoHint: Printed documents show no logo until you upload one again.
settings.printTitle: Header and footer of printed documents
settings.printHint: Choose a document and paper size, then edit its texts.
settings.defaults: Not saved yet: these are the defaults.

numbering.title: Document numbering
numbering.hint: Numbers restart every year. Counters advance only when a document is issued.

policies.payFirstHint: Always on. A service before payment needs a documented perform-first authorization.
policies.partialPayment: Allow partial payment of an invoice
policies.partialPaymentHint: Lines are settled in invoice order as money arrives.
policies.transferAlertDays: Alert on transfers pending more than (days)
policies.transferAlertHint: Verifiers are alerted to unconfirmed bank transfers; after the same number of days they also show under the manager dashboard's "Needs attention".
policies.discountLimitsHint: Highest discount in percent of the patient share. Empty means no discount.
policies.performFirstHint: Each authorization is recorded with a reason, the approver and the time.
policies.dispenseRemainder: When stock runs short at dispensing
policies.remainderDefer: Keep the rest open to dispense later
policies.remainderRefund: Cancel the rest and refund the patient
policies.estimatedCostHint: Only doctors with the permission see it.
policies.claimsSecondApprover: A second person approves claim rebills and write-offs
policies.claimsSecondApproverHint: Rebilling a payer rejection to the patient or writing it off needs another person's username and password besides the accountant who records it. Turn off only when one accountant works alone.

departments.doctorHint: Choose a user who holds the doctor role (create the user first).
departments.consultationServiceHint: Billed automatically when a visit with this doctor opens.
departments.scheduleHint: Sessions of the same day may touch but never overlap.

reasons.label: Reason
reasons.codeRule: Capital letters, digits and _, starting with a letter.

categories.writeoff: Payer rejection: rebill or write off

catalog.kindFixed: The type of a service never changes.
catalog.nameRequired: Enter an Arabic or English name.

prices.addListHint: Prices are added in dated versions after the list is created.
prices.newVersionHint: Starts as a copy of the version effective on that date. Prices can be edited until it starts.
prices.withdrawHint: It has not started yet, so no invoice used it. It is removed with its prices; the reason is recorded in the audit log with your name and the time.
prices.bulkHint: Creates a new dated version; the current prices stay as they are.
prices.percentHint: 10 raises prices by 10%; -5 lowers them by 5%.
prices.percentRule: Enter a percentage such as 10 or -5.5.
prices.kindsHint: Leave all unchecked to change every service.
prices.previewSummary_one: {{count}} price changes by {{percent, bidi}} from {{date, bidi}}
prices.previewSummary_other: {{count}} prices change by {{percent, bidi}} from {{date, bidi}}
prices.noVersions: Add the first version to enter prices.
prices.basedOn: Copied from the version of {{date, bidi}}
prices.locked: It has started, so its prices may be on approved invoices. Create a new version to change prices.
prices.priceRule: Enter an amount such as 15000 or 2500.50.
prices.firstVersionHint: Nothing on this list is in effect yet. Copy the current prices of another list to start from, then adjust them. A version that starts today is fixed at once, so it needs copied prices.
prices.copyFromHint: The current version of another list is copied into this one.
prices.copyRequiredToday: A version that starts today needs copied prices. Choose a list, or start tomorrow.

payers.addHint: Add the contract, coverage rules and exclusions on the next screen.
payers.datesRule: The contract cannot end before it starts.
payers.rulesHint: The most specific rule applies: a service, then its type, then the payer default.

ruleKinds.ceiling: Payer pays up to a ceiling

payers.amountRule: Enter a number such as 70 or 2500.50.
payers.preApprovalHint: The payer's approval reference is required on the line.
payers.exampleIncomplete: Fill in the rule to see how a line splits.
payers.exclusionsHint: Excluded services are never covered: the patient pays all of them.

banks.hint: The code never changes once saved. A transfer reference is unique per bank.
banks.activeHint: An inactive bank leaves the cashier's list; its earlier payments keep it.
banks.emptyDescription: Add the banks and wallets patients transfer through, such as Bankak.

rules.title: No coverage rules yet
rules.description: Without a rule the payer covers nothing: the patient pays the whole price. Add a default rule, then rules for kinds or single services.

exclusions.title: No exclusions
exclusions.description: Everything a rule covers is covered. Exclude a service or a kind of service the contract does not pay for.

departments.title: No departments yet
departments.description: Departments group rooms, doctors and services. Add the first one.

rooms.title: No rooms yet
rooms.description: Rooms are where doctors see patients. Add one and link it to a department.

doctors.title: No doctor profiles yet
doctors.description: Give a user with the doctor role a profile to set their department, consultation fee and weekly clinic times.

reasons.title: No reasons in this list
reasons.description: Staff pick from this list when they need to give a reason. Add the first one.

payers.title: No payers yet
payers.description: Insurers, companies and other payers that share the bill. Add one with its contract dates.

services.title: No services yet
services.description: The services, tests and items the center bills for. Add the first one.

priceItems.title: No prices in this version
priceItems.description: Services without a price here cannot be billed to this list. Add the services and their prices.

priceItemsLocked.title: No prices in this version
priceItemsLocked.description: This version is in effect and cannot change. Create a new version to add prices.

centerPage.identityHint: Taken from the center settings, as printed on documents.
centerPage.name: Name
centerPage.aboutHint: Two or three short sentences: what the center offers.
centerPage.hoursHint: Patients see today's status from these hours.
centerPage.noHours: No opening hours yet. The section stays off the page until you add them.
centerPage.closesAfter: Closing time must be after opening time
centerPage.contactHint: The main phone comes from the center settings. Leave a field empty to leave it out.
centerPage.whatsappHint: Like 0912 345 678; numbers from other countries start with +.
centerPage.addressHint: The address comes from the center settings. Add how to find the building.
centerPage.departmentsHint: Active departments, from the departments screen. Untick one to keep it off the page; its doctors are left out too.
centerPage.doctorsHint: Active doctors with clinic hours, from their weekly schedules. Untick one to keep them off the page.
centerPage.listNotAllowed: You cannot view this list. Ask an administrator.
centerPage.announcementsSectionHint: Show the notices below on the page while they are active and in date.
centerPage.announcementsHint: Short notices for patients, such as holiday closures. Each shows between its dates while it is active.
centerPage.activeHint: Turn off to hide the notice without deleting it.
centerPage.titleRule: Give a title in Arabic or English
centerPage.datesRule: The last day cannot be before the first day
centerPage.heroHint: A short title and one sentence under the center's name at the top of the page.
centerPage.facilitiesHint: Up to 20 short names, such as laboratory or pharmacy.
centerPage.reasonsHint: Up to 8 reasons, each a title and an optional sentence. Shown when the list is not empty.
centerPage.rowTitleRule: Give a title in Arabic or English
centerPage.servicesHint: Show the names of chosen services under their departments. Prices never appear on the page.
centerPage.insuranceHint: Show the names of chosen payers. Contract terms never appear on the page.
centerPage.faqSectionHint: Show the questions below on the page.
centerPage.testimonialsSectionHint: Show approved testimonials on the page.
centerPage.accessibilityHint: How a wheelchair user or an older patient reaches and moves inside the center. Shown when not empty.
centerPage.policiesHint: Shown in the page footer. The cancellation policy also shows beside "fees are paid at reception".
centerPage.mapsUrlHint: A link starting with https:// that opens the center in a maps app. Nothing is embedded in the page.
centerPage.mapsRule: Give a link that starts with https://

media.title: Images
media.hint: PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 2 MB each. The first active hero image shows at the top; gallery images under About; doctor photos are chosen per doctor below.
media.altHint: For people who cannot see the image.
media.removeConfirm: Remove this image? A doctor using it loses the photo.

faq.title: Questions and answers
faq.hint: Common questions of patients, in the order shown.
faq.removeConfirm: Remove this question from the page?
faq.activeHint: Turn off to hide it without removing it.
faq.questionRule: Give the question in Arabic or English
faq.answerRule: Give the answer in Arabic or English

testimonials.title: Testimonials
testimonials.hint: Typed by staff from what patients said, with their consent. A testimonial shows only after a manager approves it; changing its words needs a new approval.
testimonials.authorHint: For example "A patient from Omdurman". Avoid full names.
testimonials.textRule: Give the words in Arabic or English

doctorProfiles.title: Doctors on the website
doctorProfiles.hint: Qualifications, a short biography (up to 400 characters) and a photo for each doctor shown.
doctorProfiles.noPhotos: Upload an image as a doctor photo above to choose it here.

publicSite.switchesHint: Each switch is enforced by the server. With all three off, nothing of this center is public.
publicSite.siteHint: Shows the center page at the site address (/) and at /portal. Its content is edited on the center page screen.
publicSite.bookingHint: Signed-in patients choose a doctor, a day and a free slot. Patients can still cancel their bookings when this is off.
publicSite.trackingHint: Patients sign in to see their appointments, results, prescriptions and bills. Turning it off signs every patient out and stops new access codes.
publicSite.rulesHint: Apply to every booking made by a patient online.
publicSite.reasonHint: Kept in the audit trail with your name and the time.
publicSite.range: Enter a whole number from {{min}} to {{max}}.
